course_name: 離岸風機工程調查與施工
outline:
離岸風電為重要之綠色能源，離岸風電工程與傳統陸上工程具有極大差異。本課程介紹離岸風電工程，涵蓋規劃、調查、設計、製造、運輸與施工等各階段之關鍵課題，並介紹引用之國際標準，其知識可應用於各種離岸工程。期能啟發學生對海洋工程之興趣。

Offshore wind power is an important form of green energy, and offshore wind engineering differs greatly from traditional onshore engineering. This course introduces offshore wind engineering, covering key topics in each phase, including planning, site investigation, design, manufacturing, transportation, and installation, as well as the international standards referenced throughout. The knowledge gained can be applied to various types of offshore engineering. The course aims to inspire students' interest in marine engineering.
